Web application

Runs in the browser; built with Vite.
Pages, sign-in and same-origin API client

executes business rules and hold-expiry timer

div.style: color: rgb(23, 37, 84) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

div.style: color: rgb(124, 45, 18) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Legend
Pale blue: person; blue: ConnectSphere container; grey: external system.
Arrows show caller-to-dependency interactions, including their protocol.
Local development uses the Vite /api proxy. Legacy HS256 verifies with a backend secret instead of JWKS.
